description: Land Acquisition - Maberiyathenna and Bambaragahadeniya, Medadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District - Amendment to the Notice Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1953/26 of 11.02.2016 by Thihagoda D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific parcels of land (including descriptions, extents, locations, and claimants) for public purposes (military use and reservoir construction). The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
